html:
Quest Giver: Fighter Equipment Token Master

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Go talk with the Fighter Token Master in Townston.

Quest Reward: None listed

Return to: Fighter Equipment Token Master

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: King's Coin Counterfeit Conspiracy, Part 2c

Zone: The Shadow's Embrace (Quest)

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Go talk with the Fighter Token Master in Townston.

Offer:

Sir Ving is always a bit nosey. I wonder why?

Anyway, yes, I have been getting some bad King's Coins. I told the Townston Commander, but he said he's got higher priorities at the moment. I want to be reimbursed for them! Anyway, that's not your problem. There's some guy in the Lower Shadow's Embrace that people keep talking about. I bet he's been passing out the bad coins.

You should go check with the Fighter Token Master as well. I bet he's been getting them and didn't even realize it.

I'll give you copies of my sales receipts, if that's what you need to stop me from getting bad King's Coins.

Turn-in:

I'm the Fighter Token Master. Can I help you?

Objectives:

  • Sales Receipts ×1

Level range: 47–100
